instruction: I need VLC to support extremely high volume for my low-quality audio files. Can you set the maximum volume to 400% in VLC?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting VLC's max volume to 400% (qt-max-volume=400 in vlcrc config file). Nearly identical to original task but with different target value (400% vs 200%).
